wholePhysicalScope: The museum’s identity and connected outer shape are established by named OpenStreetMap way 491583514. Separate mapped outlines control the Green Dome, fountain, small historic tombs and the lodge’s kitchen and cells. A published architectural survey checks the 30.5 m square mausoleum core and 68 m by 84 m courtyard.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the turquoise tomb tower, individual lead domes and the court ensemble. Near levels add fluted tile, ashlar windows and measured dervish-cell features.
limitations: Model depicts the standing historic exterior. Lower roof junctions, most small window openings and the exact terrace and paving courses are approximations.
The cube and cylindrical drum follow documented proportions and the native roof plan. Fine polychrome tile and inscription detail are simplified.
The nearby two-minareted Selimiye Mosque is a separate landmark. The map control includes it to disambiguate the museum.
